heading: About Me
paragraphs: Most of my current study is around LLM reasoning and the security of AI agents. I'm interested in how a model arrives at an answer, what it treats as trustworthy, and what happens when it interacts with tools or external data. These are the questions that keep me returning to the papers and the code.

I'm still learning how to investigate these problems carefully. I spend time working through the assumptions behind a method, thinking about failure cases, and trying ideas in small implementations. My research is ongoing, and I'm building the skills to evaluate results and explain the limitations of the work clearly.

Alongside that study, I contribute to software projects and hackathon teams. Building interfaces and application workflows gives me practical questions to bring back to my reading. I also tutor students in Classes 10–12 and admission preparation; finding a clear explanation for someone else often helps me see what I still need to understand.
